faq.q: Which schools are in Pebble Hill?
faq.a: Pebble Hill Traditional Elementary (K–7), at 246 52a St, Delta, is physically in the sub-area on the BC Ministry of Education's SD37 school list. Catchments are address-based — check the exact address in the SD37 locator, and do not assume a traditional school is an address's catchment school.

The City of Delta's multi-use park at 411 Milsom Wynd, Tsawwassen — it sits partially atop Metro Vancouver reservoirs, offers sport courts, sports fields, trails and washrooms, and has a designated off-leash dog area under the BC Hydro right-of-way accessible from Milsom Wynd; hours are dawn to dusk.

faq.q: How do Pebble Hill residents reach the Canada Line?
faq.a: By TransLink route 601, whose Tsawwassen routing runs via 52A St, 4 Ave and Milsom Wynd — through the sub-area itself — to South Delta Exchange, then via Highway 17, Ladner Exchange, Highway 17A and Highway 99 to Bridgeport Station.

faq.q: What plan governs development in Pebble Hill?
faq.a: The Delta Official Community Plan 2024, "Housing Our Future", Bylaw No. 8400, adopted July 8, 2024 — a single consolidated plan with land-use designations in its Land Use Plan (s. 1.5) and no separate Tsawwassen area-plan schedule; Delta's SSMUH zoning updates under it allow up to four units on single-detached and duplex lots.
